nodes.description: owner: privileged address of the contract, set in constructor and mutable through transferOwnership/acceptOwnership/setOwner
pendingOwner: intermediate owner candidate used by the two-step ownership transfer
admins mapping(address=>uint256): authorization table used by the onlyAdmin modifier
_implement: address of the delegatecall logic implementation stored in ProxyStorage
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for all authorization checks in Owner and read inside the proxy fallback
transferOwnership(address _nextOwner) external onlyOwner: sets pendingOwner
acceptOwnership() external: pendingOwner must equal msg.sender, then owner is set to sender
setOwner(address _nextOwner) external onlyOwner: directly overwrites owner
setAdmin(address _admin, uint256 auth) external onlyOwner: writes authorization level into admins
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner), gates all privileged Owner/ProxyEntry functions
onlyAdmin modifier: require(sender == owner || admins[sender] != 0)
setProxyLogic(address logicAddr) external onlyOwner returns(bool): public entry to repoint the proxy logic, calls _setProxyLogic
_setProxyLogic(address logicAddr) internal: assigns _implement = logicAddr
fallback() external payable: loads _implement and performs an assembly delegatecall forwarding calldata, then returns/reverts with returndata
receive() external payable: empty payable receiver
Owner constructor: admins[owner = msg.sender] = 1, initializing owner and admin level
ProxyEntry constructor(address logicAddr): calls _setProxyLogic to initialize the implementation
delegatecall(gas(), addr, 0, calldatasize(), 0, 0) inside the fallback: executes external logic code with this contract's storage, address and msg.sender
_nextOwner parameter of transferOwnership(address)
_nextOwner parameter of setOwner(address)
_admin parameter of setAdmin(address,uint256)
auth parameter of setAdmin(address,uint256)
logicAddr parameter of the ProxyEntry constructor
logicAddr parameter of setProxyLogic(address)
logicAddr parameter of _setProxyLogic(address)
sender local variable (payable(msg.sender)) in the onlyAdmin modifier
sender local variable (payable(msg.sender)) in acceptOwnership
addr local variable in fallback holding the cached _implement value used as delegatecall target
result local variable produced by the assembly delegatecall switch in fallback

edges.reason: Owner constructor assigns owner = payable(msg.sender), so the caller becomes the privileged owner
Owner constructor writes admins[msg.sender] = 1, granting the caller admin authorization
onlyOwner requires payable(msg.sender) == owner before executing the guarded function body
the onlyOwner modifier reads the owner state variable to compare it with msg.sender
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier
setOwner is gated by the onlyOwner modifier
setAdmin is gated by the onlyOwner modifier
setProxyLogic is gated by the onlyOwner modifier
onlyAdmin derives its local sender from msg.sender before the authorization check
onlyAdmin reads admins[sender] to decide whether the caller is authorized
transferOwnership stores the caller-supplied _nextOwner into pendingOwner
acceptOwnership derives its sender from msg.sender for the pendingOwner check
acceptOwnership requires sender == pendingOwner, consuming the stored pending owner
acceptOwnership promotes the msg.sender-derived local sender into the owner state variable
setOwner directly overwrites owner with the caller-supplied _nextOwner
setAdmin uses _admin as the key when writing the admins authorization mapping
setAdmin stores the caller-supplied auth value as the admin authorization level
the ProxyEntry constructor forwards its logicAddr argument into _setProxyLogic
the ProxyEntry constructor executes _setProxyLogic during deployment
setProxyLogic forwards its logicAddr argument into _setProxyLogic
_setProxyLogic assigns its logicAddr parameter into the _implement state variable
setProxyLogic, only reachable by the owner, calls _setProxyLogic to repoint the implementation
_setProxyLogic writes the _implement state variable that the fallback later uses
the fallback reads the _implement state variable and caches it as the delegatecall target address
the fallback unconditionally performs the assembly delegatecall with the stored implementation address
the delegatecall transfers execution to external implementation code while keeping this contract's storage and msg.sender context
the addr local (cached _implement) is the target operand of the delegatecall
the delegatecall success flag returned into result drives the revert/return switch
the delegatecall preserves the caller-controlled msg.sender for the executed logic code
